shown.message:
The `bias_reference.csv` job finished, and I delivered the new table to `paper-repo` `dev` (e79190a).

The table now has a constant row: absolute held-out R² of log|bias| is −0.239 for a held-out training mean, on the same 1224 cells and folds. The other diagnostic tables re-ran bit-identically.

Measured against that constant, the paper's sentence that every data-computable predictor has a negative absolute held-out R² is still correct. The comparison with the constant is more informative:

| Predictor | Held-out R² of log\|bias\| |
|---|---|
| Constant (held-out training mean) | −0.239 |
| Degree benchmarks (best one, p(1−p)) | −0.257 |
| S̄ | −0.216 |
| Corner × curvature | −0.121 |
| Noise-adjusted S (exploratory) | −0.062 |
| Population-OLS prediction (needs the true response) | 0.987 |

I posted these in `experiment-repo`#11 and suggested `paper-repo` add the constant to the sentence. I gave no interval for the gaps to the constant, because this table has none.

The confirmatory blocks C and H and the HT shards are still running, and the GNN jobs are still queued.
